course.title: Fundamentals of Transportation Engineering
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value:
A horizontal curve is to be designed for a section of a highway having a 10   
design speed of 80mi/h. Assume, fy = 0.14.   
(i) If the physical conditions restrict the radius of the curve to 600 ft.,   
what value is required for the super elevation at this curve?   
(ii) Is it a good design?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
